harness_defect_repaired_this_cycle.defect: test_artifacts.py::_gate_files() returned every results/audit/.../CYCLE_*_GATE.json as one undifferentiated set and then applied the independent-audit contract (gate in {PASS,REVISE}; required_fixes is a list; safe_to_integrate; three exact claim-ceiling literals) to all of them. The audit tree legitimately holds two artifact classes: independent audits of record (CYCLE_38839354961, CYCLE_38841035773, gate=PASS) and producer-authored placement copies that the factory-wide audit-artifact placement requirement MANDATES writing into the same directory (CYCLE_38845649012, CYCLE_38846758718, gate=TERMINATE, self-declared via artifact_provenance_warning). Placement copies record the team's cycle disposition, not a product audit verdict, so the suite was red-by-construction on every re-dispatch. Three consecutive dispatches shipped a permanently failing suite, which is worse than a wrong assertion because it trains the gate reader to ignore test failures.
harness_defect_repaired_this_cycle.fix: New module frontier/frontier-counter-label-integrity/frontier_counter_label_integrity/audit_contract.py routes each gate artifact to the contract of its own class and validates it; test_artifacts.py dispatches by class instead of blanket-applying one contract. The fix does NOT relax the independent-audit contract and does NOT delete or edit any historical artifact.
why_this_is_not_benchmark_weakening: The independent-audit contract is enforced VERBATIM, including the three exact-case claim-ceiling literals, the gate tuple, required_fixes and safe_to_integrate. Verified by mutation M5: downcasing 'BASELINE ONLY' in the real audit of record still fails the contract.

A new anti-vacuity invariant requires at least one independent audit of record to exist and forbids any unclassified artifact, so routing the two classes apart can never make the audit requirement vacuous. That is precisely what a naive 'just skip the placement copies' fix would have broken. Verified by mutation M2: deleting both audits of record fails the tree.
The placement-copy contract is NEW and did not exist before; it was previously enforced not at all. It is not a relaxation of anything.
RULES.json is frozen and untouched (sha256 unchanged, 0-line git diff from the freeze commit). No threshold, lexicon, criterion or verdict moved.
No historical artifact was edited or deleted: git status shows only one modified test file and two new files.
The suite went 64 passed / 2 failed -> 96 passed / 0 failed, i.e. 32 additional assertions, none removed.

adversarial_review.method: an independent fresh-context subagent was given the role of refuting the change, with the pre-change test file, the frozen artifact hashes and the benchmark-weakening rule as its brief, and a sandbox in /tmp/opencode
defects_the_review_found_in_the_first_ve: The normalized claim-limit matcher was vacuous: a fallback regex dropped the 'supporting' anchor, so a 53-character ceiling ('no assert contrary limiting baseline only 38828034436') passed, and so did the SEMANTIC INVERSE of this team's ceiling ('Every specific decision IS supporting, contrary and limiting. No assertion limit applies.'). That was weaker than the pre-change test on this dimension, so the 'strictly stronger' claim was false as first written.

A producer file could read as an independent audit: the gate check was a denylist of {PASS, REVISE}, so invented verdicts (PASS_WITH_CAVEATS, ACCEPTED, AUDIT_PASS) passed, and the audit-only key list was an incomplete denylist.
The provenance-warning check was a substring test, so a warning that denied authority in one clause and claimed it in another satisfied it.
classify_gate_payload routed purely on one self-declared key, so an audit-shaped file could pick the weaker contract.
repairs_applied_after_review: Claim-limit check now requires negation + assertion verb + supporting + contrary + limiting WITHIN A SINGLE SENTENCE, so scattered words and the semantic inverse are both rejected while legitimately reworded ceilings still pass.
Placement-copy gate check changed from a denylist to a CLOSED allow-list of cycle dispositions (TERMINATE, HOLD, PAUSE, BLOCKED, REROUTE), so an invented near-miss verdict cannot pass.
Authority-claiming key denylist extended (audit_verdict, verdict, independently_audited, audit_of_record, integrate, audit_pass).
Provenance warning must now also not contradict itself by claiming authority.

Class routing requires the full audit signature (required_fixes + safe_to_integrate + team) to be an independent audit; anything that is neither clearly Class A nor clearly Class B is UNCLASSIFIED and fails the tree.
The independent-audit contract no longer skips the exact-literal check when claim_ceiling is a non-string; a non-string ceiling is itself a failure.

adversarial_review.residual_weakness_declared: A producer file carrying the complete audit signature (required_fixes + safe_to_integrate + team) is indistinguishable from a genuine audit by any test. That is a property of the artifact medium, not of this contract; it is mitigated by the provenance disclosure requirement, by the anti-vacuity invariant, and by the audit job being a separate job from the producer job.
